subject.description: Login is a claim as typed; account is a canonical account. At least one is required.
subject.title: SupportHistorySubject

until.description: Exclusive upper bound; at most 31 days after from.

cursor.description: Opaque position bound to the same query; never authorizing.

audit_reference.description: Unverified ticket-like annotation recorded in the audit log only.
audit_reference.title: SupportHistoryAuditReference

include_ban_context.description: Adds ban_contexts and ban_history: every subject request of this page that brute-force protection rejected, linked server-side to the recorded ban instances effective at that time (also bans that began before the window). Absent or false keeps the answer unchanged. Independent of response_mode.

response_mode.description: Presentation only. detailed (the default) returns full attempts; compact returns attempt_summaries and an empty attempts list. Neither mode changes rights: the projection always follows the token scopes.
response_mode.title: SupportHistoryResponseMode
